# Synthetic fixtures

Every `.spd` here was generated by snspd-lib's `tests/generate_fixtures.py`
and `generate_btrees.py` at tag v1.0.0.
They contain synthetic SQLite rows and generated image bytes. No private input
was used. FuzzOpen contains Go native fuzz encodings of a selected subset.
The main grid has unequal axis extents (TX 1952…1955, TY 1953…1957),
and `grid-boundary` covers column-major IDs 0, 4095 and 4096.

Regenerate using `python3 -B scripts/update-seeds.py ../snspd-lib` (Python 3.9+
with a writable-schema-capable SQLite; Homebrew python3.13 works on macOS).
The script reads both generators from the documented Git revision and checks
the output filenames against `seeds.sha256` before copying files and recording
their hashes. Routine tests need neither the upstream checkout nor Python.
